title: Python Programming
tagline: Master Python from basics to advanced applications – Build real-world projects and kickstart your programming career
overview: Our Python Programming course is designed to take you from complete beginner to proficient developer. You'll learn core programming concepts, data structures, and object-oriented programming, then advance to data analysis, web development, and automation.

Through hands-on projects and industry-relevant assignments, you'll build a portfolio that showcases your skills to potential employers. The course emphasizes practical application, ensuring you can immediately apply your learning to real-world scenarios.
You'll work on multiple projects that mirror real-world scenarios, building a portfolio that demonstrates your capabilities to potential employers or clients.

By the end of this course, you'll not only master Python programming but also understand how to apply these skills in various domains including data science, web development, automation, and artificial intelligence.
learningOutcomes: Master Python syntax, variables, data types, and control structures
Implement Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts: classes, objects, inheritance
Work with Python libraries: NumPy for numerical computing, Pandas for data analysis
Perform file handling operations and exception handling
Build web applications using Flask framework and RESTful APIs
Create data visualizations using Matplotlib and Seaborn
Automate tasks and perform web scraping using BeautifulSoup and Selenium
Understand database integration with SQLite and MySQL

targetAudience.title: Students & Graduates
targetAudience.description: B.Tech, MCA, BCA, B.Sc. students looking to build programming skills for placements and higher studies.

targetAudience.title: Working Professionals
targetAudience.description: Professionals seeking to transition into tech roles, enhance automation skills, or move into data analysis.

targetAudience.title: Researchers & Analysts
targetAudience.description: Academic researchers and data analysts who need Python for data processing, visualization, and analysis.

targetAudience.title: Career Changers & Entrepreneurs
targetAudience.description: Individuals looking to switch careers to tech or entrepreneurs needing to build MVP applications.

prerequisites: Willingness to learn and practice regularly
